about: Production list for Dead Internet graphics. Ids are stable and used by the world (content/world/images.json). Replace a file by saving it under the same name; no code changes. Order matters: generate originals before the copies derived from them.

style.photo: Realistic smartphone photo, natural light, slight noise, no text overlays, no real brands.
style.profile: Square avatar, realistic, as a person would choose for themselves. Synthetic personas: subtly too smooth, with one visible AI tell.
style.ui: Fictional interface, original design, no resemblance to real products.

characters.mara: Woman, 34, warm round face, freckles, short dark curly hair, small silver hoop earrings, green parka. Use one fixed face reference for every image of Mara.

images.brief: Sunrise, old brick textile mill roof with a large painted metal sign 'CALDER MILL — EST. 1887'. Wide shot with the harbour on the left and a lamp post on the right.
